scope: Preloaded number pool with real durable scheduling / real MySQL+Redis / embedded mock telephony. No real SIP, RTP, audio, cloud models or public numbers.
dial_source: Preloaded QUEUED pool; real enqueueDue/outbox/admission/mock gateway, no HTTP creation requests

configuration.dial_cohort_sizing: fixed configured batch; live per-item token check
configuration.voice_callback_protocol: v1 for <=16; additive signed v2 for 17..64

fixtures: Isolated explicitly-consented synthetic contacts and QUEUED calls committed together; actual durable scheduler performs all admission and dial transitions. No public telephone calls.
event_time_bucket_note: Event timestamps are diagnostic only; capacity uses post-commit intervals.
superseded_note: Kept as original durable task rows, never treated as successful control dispatch. Supersession after due is reported separately and cannot erase earlier SLO misses; validity at each deadline needs independent event evidence.
task_latency_note: Upper-bound diagnostic includes execution and commit; excludes superseded tasks, is not independently collected action-dispatch evidence or a formal V3 SLO pass.

commit_rate.scope: observed saturation on this host/configuration; not a production limit or sustained capacity qualification
commit_rate.counting: unique tenant/call/attempt durable acknowledgements; JDBC commit intervals, not created_at or HTTP acceptance

measurement_note: Every measured second must have >=500 durable dial acknowledgements; all earlier cold-start buckets are retained separately and never relabelled as passes
generator: Preloaded durable QUEUED pool committed at phase start; no calls inserted as DIALING or IN_AI

observed_synthetic_lifetimes.note: Includes real application hangup commands; unfinished calls are excluded from ended-age aggregates. Diagnostic only, not formal occupancy coverage.
